evaluate_DMEstimator: evaluate a target policy using the Direct Method estimator with a value function on logged MDP trajectories
evaluate_IPSEstimator: evaluate a target policy using the Importance Sampling estimator with weighted or unweighted importance ratios
evaluate_DoublyRobustEstimator: evaluate a target policy using the Doubly Robust estimator combining IPS weights with value function estimates
evaluate_MAGICEstimator: evaluate a target policy using the MAGIC estimator with resampling and convex optimization for tighter confidence bounds
evaluate_NeuralDualDICE: evaluate a target policy using Neural Dual DICE with neural network value and zeta function training via adversarial optimization
